_design: NEW FEATURE. Mountain-specific rock feature with mountain_stone tile IDs (vs plains rocks in rock_outcrop). Vein pattern: elongated cluster (radius 3 x 1.5 ellipse) simulating geological strata. Used by mountain.json stratification layers h3-6. Denser than meadow rock outcrop. Core Keeper: exposed stone at elevation is a resource signal.

placement._: ellipseRatio 0.5 = vein is twice as long as wide, aligned to slope gradient. Denser than meadow rock_outcrop (fillDensity 0.65 vs 0.70 but larger radius).
